en: Black-and-white postcard showing the courtyard of a rustic wine tavern. In the foreground stands a large historic wooden wine press with a roof above it. Behind it is an old plastered building with shuttered windows and a door, and to the right there are garden tables and chairs under a parasol, surrounded by trees and a picket fence. Caption text is printed along the bottom of the image.
